requirements.title: Comprehensive Sales Analytics Dashboard
requirements.description: Provides a unified view of key sales metrics and analytics for informed decision-making

requirements.title: Unified Reporting and Analytics
requirements.description: Combine report building, analytics, and insights for sales performance analysis

requirements.title: Enhanced Lead and Contact Management
requirements.description: Manage leads and contacts with features for scoring, assignment, and nurturing, including company and lifecycle stage information

requirements.title: Advanced Deal and Pipeline Management
requirements.description: Includes deal staging, tracking, and forecasting for optimal sales pipeline management

requirements.title: Integrated Communication and Collaboration Tools
requirements.description: Facilitates communication through click-to-call, call recording, email integration, and calendar synchronization

requirements.title: Streamlined Sales Workflow and Process Management
requirements.description: Covers deal management, lead capture, and assignment workflows for efficient sales operations

requirements.title: Scalable and Secure Data Model
requirements.description: Incorporates lead, contact, company, deal, and activity entities with row-level security for multi-tenant isolation

requirements.title: High-Performance and Reliable System
requirements.description: Ensures 99.95% uptime, rapid data retrieval, and secure user sessions

requirements.title: Deal Pipeline Workflow
requirements.description: Deal pipeline board → Stage columns → Deal cards → Drag-and-drop → Confirmation/Win-loss reason modals
requirements.user_story: As a sales manager, I want to manage deals efficiently, so that I can track and close deals effectively
acceptance_criteria: Deal pipeline board displays required stage columns
Deal cards can be dragged and dropped between stages
Stage transitions trigger confirmation/win-loss reason modals as required

requirements.title: 9-Step Lead Conversion Workflow
requirements.description: Lead arrives → Deduplication → AI Scoring → Territory Assignment → Rep Review → BANT Qualification → Conversion Wizard → Deal Creation → Task Generation. Alternate paths: Nurture (score < 30), Disqualify (no fit)
requirements.user_story: As a sales ops manager, I want an automated lead conversion process, so that leads move efficiently through qualification

requirements.title: Sales and Marketing Workflow
requirements.description: 7-Step Deal Pipeline Progression Workflow and 6-Step Custom Report Creation Workflow combined for comprehensive sales and marketing management
requirements.user_story: As a sales and marketing manager, I want to manage sales and marketing workflows efficiently, so that I can analyze performance and make informed decisions
acceptance_criteria: All steps in both workflows execute in sequence
Reports are created with correct configuration

requirements.title: Elasticsearch Indexing with CDC and Data Partitioning
requirements.description: Elasticsearch indices for leads, contacts, deals, and activities. Real-time index updates via CDC using Debezium from PostgreSQL WAL. Index lag < 2 seconds. Data partitioned by created_at quarter. Retention: 3 years in hot storage, 7 years in cold archive.
requirements.user_story: As a system architect, I want real-time search capabilities and efficient data storage, so that users can find relevant data quickly

requirements.title: Availability & Disaster Recovery and Security & Compliance
requirements.description: System uptime SLA: 99.95% (max 21.9 minutes downtime per month). Multi-region deployment (US-East, EU-West). Data residency option for EU customers (GDPR requirement). RTO < 10 minutes, RPO < 30 seconds. SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certification required. Annual penetration testing and security audit. GDPR compliance: right to erasure (72-hour SLA), data portability (JSON/CSV export), consent management, DPA available.
requirements.user_story: As a system administrator, I want the system to be highly available, secure, and compliant with regulatory requirements, so that we can protect our customers' data and ensure business continuity

requirements.title: Clearbit and Email Integrations
requirements.description: Clearbit Enrichment API Integration for contact and company data enrichment. Email Integration with Gmail and Outlook for bidirectional email sync and logging emails to matching contact and deal records.
requirements.user_story: As a sales team member, I want to have enriched contact and company data and to automatically log emails, so that I can better understand the lead's context and track communication history
acceptance_criteria: Contact and company data enriched correctly
Emails logged to correct contact and deal records

requirements.title: Calendar and Slack Integrations
requirements.description: Calendar Integration with Google Calendar and Outlook Calendar for meeting scheduling and auto-creation of meeting records in CRM. Slack Integration for deal alerts and updates.
requirements.user_story: As a sales representative, I want to schedule meetings and receive deal alerts and updates in Slack, so that I can stay informed about deal activity and manage my time effectively
acceptance_criteria: Meeting records created for calendar events with CRM contacts
Deal alerts sent to Slack in real-time
Deal updates sent to Slack in real-time

requirements.title: Data Import, Export, and Audit Log
requirements.description: Data Import with validation, deduplication, and error reporting. Data Export in CSV and JSON formats with GDPR compliance. Audit Log for all data modifications, including user, timestamp, and old/new values.
requirements.user_story: As a sales representative, I want to import data, export data, and have an audit log available, so that I can ensure data quality and integrity
acceptance_criteria: Data imported successfully with validation, deduplication, and error reporting
Data exported successfully in CSV and JSON formats
Audit log entry created with user, timestamp, and old/new values

requirements.title: REST API and Security with Row-Level Security
requirements.description: REST API with OAuth 2.0 for custom integrations. Security and Access Control with Row-Level Security (RLS) for multi-tenant isolation and data encryption using AES-256.
requirements.user_story: As a developer, I want to use the REST API to integrate custom applications with the CRM and ensure data security, so that I can extend the CRM functionality securely
acceptance_criteria: API endpoints available for data access and manipulation
